content: FOR/AGAINST steelman-both synthesis complete 2026-05-18. The two inputs were NOT naive for/against -- both sophisticated, both accept all verification fixes. Real axis: has the epistemic posture drifted too skeptical (Doc 3, over-attenuation critique) vs is the skeptical posture correctly calibrated and defensible (Doc 4, threshold-discipline defense). OUTPUT: TWO genuine conflicts, ONE major talk-past. (1) GENUINE CONFLICT - PAIN: values-threshold not evidence conflict. Both agree on the number (Wang ~10% modeled RD, -0.5cm VAS). Collision is what that number LICENSES you to say -- meaningful-for-refractory (Doc3) vs clinically-minimal (Doc4). Does not dissolve; depends on counterfactual for treatment-resistant population. Doc3 wins framing point, Doc4 wins discipline-that-framing-must-carry-the-number. Honest verdict: an audit foregrounding the >=50% null over the moderate-certainty small effect IS a tier-error in the skeptical direction -- Doc3 correct here, stated plainly, not balanced away. (2) GENUINE CONFLICT - PSYCHOSIS: sharpest. Doc4 strongest move (pleiotropy SHIELD, weaponize, fractures drug-alone-causes-disease) pushed to full strength IS the mirror-image of the exact symmetric-evidence error this project exists to avoid -- skeptical-direction overreach. Verification pass already established contributory model SURVIVES + potency signal survives PRS adjustment (Quattrone/DiForti 2021 OR~5.09 independent of PRS). Split verdict: Doc4 better on pure causal-inference (clean arrow fractured), Doc3 better on public-health consequence (fracture does NOT weaken adolescent/high-potency warning; shield/weaponize rhetoric is the actual danger). True at different altitudes with different consequences -- NOT a midpoint. (3) TALK-PAST - ENTOURAGE (most useful output): Doc3 and Doc4 appear opposed, are not. Doc4 own tripartite decomposition resolves Doc3 complaint: split entourage into (a) receptor synergy [unproven, Santiago/Heblinski hold] (b) pharmacokinetic enhancement [plausible] (c) additive parallel effects [real human POC, Spindle 2024]. Spindle limonene = (c) not (a). Doc3 defends (c), Doc4 attacks conflation of (c) with (a). Never opposed. Entire entourage controversy substantially definitional talk-past; NAMING that is the synthesis, not adjudicating it.
